# Shree Ashapura Industries

> Your trust, our mission. Established 1990. Manufacturer and supplier of fasteners and machine components for the lock and furniture industry, plus precision turned parts, press parts and plastic moulded parts. Special-purpose products developed to customer requirement and design. Dahisar (East), Mumbai, India.

## Products

Range: M2 to M14 / #2 to #14, length 3 to 100 mm. Materials: M.S., S.S., brass, aluminium, copper, EN8 high tensile, plastic. Kits for furniture and locks; parts made to customer drawings and raw material.

- [Screws, Bolts & Nuts](/products/screws-fasteners): hex screw, nut bolt, step bolt, projection weld screw, Phillips screw, chipboard screw, carriage bolt, flange bolt, special screws, dome nut, nyloc nut, flange nut
- [Washers](/products/washers): plain, spring, circlip, lock washers
- [Plastic Components](/products/plastic-components): caps and legs, leveller, adjustable glide base, moulded plastic parts (PP, LD, ABS, HD-Nylon, EPDM; colour as required)
- [Brackets & Press Parts](/products/brackets-press-parts): L bracket, C bracket, press parts
- [Brass Parts](/products/brass-parts): nozzles, turned brass parts, pins (size as required)
- [Studs, Pins & Turned Parts](/products/studs-pins-turned): studs, taper pin, cotter pin, machine parts
- [Furniture Fittings & Cams](/products/furniture-fittings): cams, door handles, bed handles, lock components
- Custom products made to your drawing (AutoCAD 2D & 3D)

## Manufacturing (units 24 & 25)

- Cold heading: 5 machines, 1.6 – 7.5 mm
- Thread rolling: 8 machines, 3 – 50 mm
- Slotting and BT: 4 machines, 4 – 55 mm
- Heat treatment and plating via approved partners
- Also: Traub A25 (1.6 – 25 mm), drilling and tapping, grinding, milling, lathe, drum polish, welding

## Quality

- ISO 9001:2015 quality system
- First-piece approval, then in-process checks every 2 hours
- Calibrated verniers, micrometers, thread ring and plug gauges, HRC hardness testing
- PPAP documentation; part of Lean Cluster Mumbai
